name: Rude Awakening
summary: Newly awakened Forsaken leave Deathknell's crypts to face an unfamiliar life. Freed from the Lich King's grip, you are sent down the hill, away from the incinerators, to learn what comes next from Shadow Priest Sarvis.

sections.title: A Grave Beginning
sections.body: In Deathknell's damp, subterranean crypt, the chill greets you as you open your eyes to undeath. Undertaker Mordo watches over the newly buried, sorting those who regain free will from those bound for the burning pits. Many rise to find rot, cold stone, and confusion. By chance, they have slipped the Scourge's grasp.

sections.title: Breaking the Grip of the Frozen Throne
sections.body: Before reaching the chapel, you must face a grim truth: you were once a mindless tool of the Lich King. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner broke that psychic enslavement, freeing remnants of your former humanity to reclaim independent thought. Leaving the tomb and heading down into Deathknell begins your life in a world where both the living and the Scourge see you as an abomination to be destroyed.

faq.q: Why was I in a crypt?
faq.answer: You died during the Third War, from plague or violence, and were buried in Tirisfal Glades. In Deathknell, the newly risen are watched to see whether they regain their minds or sink into mindless rot.

Undertaker Mordo cares for Deathknell's crypt. He watches over the newly awakened, sends those who keep their sanity to the town chapel, and disposes of those who fail to awaken with their minds intact.

faq.q: Why did Mordo mention throwing people into the fire?
faq.answer: Not every corpse raised from the grave regains free will or steady thoughts. Those who awaken mad or purely feral cannot join Forsaken society, so they are destroyed and burned to prevent rampages.

faq.q: Who freed me from the Lich King?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, known as the Banshee Queen, broke free of the Lich King's psychic domination as his power waned. She gathered other free-willed undead beneath her banner and founded the Forsaken to fight their former master and hostile living remnants.

faq.q: Where is Shadow Priest Sarvis located?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Sarvis is inside the damaged chapel at the base of the hill in Deathknell. Leave the crypt and follow the cobblestone path downhill to the chapel entrance.

faq.q: Who are the Forsaken fighting against?
faq.answer: The Forsaken wage a two-front war for survival. They fight the Scourge, which seeks to reclaim or destroy them, and human zealots and surviving settlements that see no difference between them and mindless monsters.

angles.text: As an Undead, you have shed the Scourge's shackles and begin a spiteful, free life among the Forsaken.
As a Priest, you meet the Forsaken priesthood through Shadow Priest Sarvis, where spiritual devotion takes new meaning after undeath.
As a member of the Horde, you enter a fragile alliance formed from sheer necessity against mutual extinction.
